purpose.summary: This is the reception/patient-registration screen component (U02) of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles outpatient reception, patient lookup by number or name, insurance confirmation, appointment management, and transitions to related screens such as patient registration and prescription entry. It is a large batch/online program managing patient visit reception workflows.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt system)

Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2000–2017
PUSH notification support added in version 05.00.00 (2017)
verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments are in Japanese (likely EUC-JP or UTF-8), causing garbled display of non-ASCII characters. This is a well-known production open-source medical system (JMA ORCA). The program_type is listed as online-cics as a proxy for 'online screen program' — it does not use CICS but uses a similar SPA-based screen management architecture proprietary to ORCA. Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the full file is 8564 lines.
